$comment: AEO probe question bank. The first 24 questions are the original starter bank (commit f620188). Keep their ids and text unchanged: the 2026-10-01 baseline is keyed on them, so compare them separately from the rest. The rest were added 2026-10-01. The new questions were written by hand. Topics and local terms (ventanita, fritanga, pan con lechón, viandas) were checked against Miami press coverage found by web search (Miami New Times, The Infatuation, Telemundo 51, Diario las Américas). No People Also Ask, Reddit or Search Console data was captured yet; add real queries from those when available. Entity questions use only the business name and city from data-import/listings.json, never other listing detail. Spanish is written the way Miami speakers say it, not translated word for word; ES ids end in -es. Intent rule for new questions: hours, open or not, reservations and similar → fact; what is it, what is it like, what is it known for → entity; history → fact. intent: best-of | near-me | fact | events | entity
